choice_basis: Selected for this study before examining measurements or correlation results; one common character, same label for all writers and repetitions.
calibration: Divide raw max-minus-min ink-coordinate extents by the site ratio documented by dataset authors: UJI=100 ink units/mm, UPV=152 ink units/mm.
dependence_analysis_unit: The 60 writer-level paired means, averaging both repetitions separately for width and height
inclusion_rule: All source samples with exact character label a; both repetitions of all 60 writers
exclusion_rule: Other character labels only; no selected glyphs dropped or selected using their measured values
planned_site_sensitivity: Report association separately for UJI and UPV as well as pooled calibrated writer means
